All physical and novelty gates remain open.
material_updates.scope: A source-reported compatible finite-pitch electromechanical model gives an all-amplitude global path inequality for a selected known-input polarization transfer under explicit positive spatial and scalar-curvature margins. Refined synthetic cycles show fast failure and slower success; one unoptimized direct-field pulse wins at T=20. Exact actuator reset also rules out nonuniform pattern writing under the same connected one-dimensional bounded-amplitude contract.
